programmes.d: Based on the best-selling book, 16-year-old Katniss volunteers to take her sister's place in the Hunger Games.
Katniss and Peeta become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the Hunger Games sparks a rebellion.
Katniss is rescued by rebels and brought to District 13 where she becomes The Mockingjay.
Katniss and a team of rebels from District 13 prepare for the final battle that will decide the fate of Panem.
